craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of joined debate — Sāṅkhya fairly stated then page-turned. Verdict hammer: triple-stranded → godless. Short line, cold close. Rejected: (a) softening godless → killed: verdict is cold. Read aloud: MA-hat-LED … AND-there-BY: GOD-less SĀṄ-khya.

lines: Mahat-led, torrent-like in change, triple-stranded root self —
l4.sanskrit_cite: mahadādivikāraughapariṇāmasvabhāvakam triguṇātma pradhānaṃ ca tena sāṃkhyamanīśvaram

reads_against.argmap: What of Sāṅkhya? → Verdict on Sāṅkhya: three-natured pradhāna — thereby godless.
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
